svg.title: K-SACCR | Replacement cost and potential future exposure
svg.desc: The exposure value is alpha times replacement cost plus potential future exposure. Replacement cost under a margin agreement is shown on a value path; the PFE is the add-on aggregated level by level times a multiplier that falls when collateral exceeds the value of the trades.

text.font-family: Georgia, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Replacement cost and potential future exposure

text.tspan: RC = max(V − C, TH + MTA − NICA, 0)

svg.text: V: net market value · C: net collateral held after haircuts · TH: threshold · MTA: minimum transfer amount · NICA: net independent collateral

svg.text: Here V − C exceeds TH + MTA − NICA, so RC = V − C. Had V stayed inside the band, RC would be TH + MTA − NICA.
